data.title: University of Beispielstadt – Erasmus+ Exchange Next Steps
data.summary: The International Office of the University of Beispielstadt confirms Priya Sharma's nomination for an Erasmus+ exchange semester at the University of Musterholm in winter 2026/27 and asks her to submit the signed Learning Agreement via the Mobility-Online portal by 15 May 2026.
data.explanation: This letter confirms your Erasmus+ nomination and tells you what to do next: upload your signed Learning Agreement to the Mobility-Online portal by 15 May 2026. Without it, the university cannot forward your application to the host university in Musterholm, so your exchange place could be at risk. Note that today's date is well after 15 May 2026, so if you have not yet submitted this document you should contact the International Office immediately to check whether the deadline can still be met or whether alternative arrangements are needed.
